entries.notes: Reverse-pairing review: OZ v5.2.0 _update moves _totalSupply whenever either side is zero, so an ordinary transfer to address(0) burns (paired), not the 'zero-address-transfer-without-supply-change' blocker. Note: privileged-zero-to-zero-mint-possible: mint/burn (bridge adapter only). Blacklisting (notBlacklisted on msg.sender/from/to in the _update override) reverts transfers for blacklisted addresses; it never moves supply or emits events. OFT identity: the configured token is the ERC20 itself (not the OFT); the OFT is OAdapter 0xffa10065…bae5 (fully verified on Blockscout, constructor arg 0 = token proxy 0x0a1a…82ef, LayerZero v2 OFTCore) whose _debit/_credit call IMintableBurnable burn/mint on the token — exactly the zero-address-Transfer pairing the P4 plan requires.
